INSERT INTO audio_client_codes(email,code_hash,attempts,created_at,expires_at,used_at,session_token_hash)
      SELECT ?,?,0,?,?,NULL,NULL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT p.request_id FROM (SELECT request_id,revoked_at FROM audio_projects UNION ALL SELECT request_id,revoked_at FROM software_projects WHERE content_deleted_at IS NULL) p
  JOIN owner_requests r ON r.id=p.request_id
  WHERE r.email=? AND r.status<>'withdrawn' AND p.revoked_at IS NULL)
      ON CONFLICT(email) DO UPDATE SET code_hash=excluded.code_hash,attempts=0,
      created_at=excluded.created_at,expires_at=excluded.expires_at,used_at=NULL,session_token_hash=NULL
      WHERE audio_client_codes.created_at<=? OR audio_client_codes.used_at IS NOT NULL OR audio_client_codes.expires_at<=?

      SELECT p.request_id,'code-issued',? FROM (SELECT request_id,revoked_at FROM audio_projects UNION ALL SELECT request_id,revoked_at FROM software_projects WHERE content_deleted_at IS NULL) p JOIN owner_requests r ON r.id=p.request_id
      WHERE r.email=? AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audio_client_codes WHERE email=? AND code_hash=? AND created_at=?)
